title: Indian Market News Brief — 09 Nov 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Large buying by foreign investors and lower oil prices may help market sentiment. Global shipping tensions in the Middle East and weaker Muhurat trading performance may pressure stocks. Mixed profit results across consumer companies leave sector trends unclear.

stories.headline: Global AI sell-off turns into India's gain as FPIs pump ₹46,000 crore in 5 sessions; will the buying spree sustain?
stories.summary:
Foreign investors bought Indian shares worth 45,970 crore rupees in five trading sessions in November.
This helped the Nifty index report its strongest weekly gain since February 2021.
Global investors moved funds away from artificial intelligence companies into Indian markets.
Lower crude oil prices and strong company earnings supported the inflows.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Large buying by foreign funds could lift prices across major index stocks.

stories.headline: Oil falls on open as Trump says fresh Iran attacks 'unlikely'
stories.summary:
Crude oil prices fell at the start of the trading week.
The US President stated that new military attacks on Iran were unlikely as long as talks continue.
However, both countries reported that ships were hit near the Strait of Hormuz.
Energy supply routes remain affected by these shipping strikes.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Falling oil prices can lower fuel expenses for Indian companies and support overall market sentiment.

stories.headline: Muhurat Trading 2026: Samvat 2082 ends, Samvat 2083 begins - Sensex, Nifty end in red first time after 2017 | Reasons
stories.summary:
Indian benchmark indices closed lower in the special Muhurat trading session.
This was the first negative Muhurat session close for the Sensex and Nifty since 2017.
Higher oil prices and Middle East conflicts placed pressure on equities.
A weaker rupee, foreign investor selling and higher US bond returns weighed on prices.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Foreign selling and high global loan costs could keep pressure on large Indian shares.

stories.headline: ICICI Bank, Divi's among 14 NSE 500 stocks hit new highs in Muhurat session
stories.summary:
Divi's Laboratories reported a 64 percent increase in second quarter net profit.
The stock price jumped 6 percent to reach a record high of 10,950 rupees.
Fourteen stocks in the top 500 index reached new record high prices during the session.
ICICI Bank was also among the stocks touching new highs.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong quarterly earnings in major pharmaceutical and banking shares could encourage buyers.

stories.headline: Bosch bonus issue, stock split: 1 share to become 20 after 38% rally in one year! Check ratio, record date, returns
stories.summary:
Bosch approved a plan to divide its shares in a 1 to 5 ratio and issue bonus shares in a 3 to 1 ratio.
The plans require final approval from company shareholders.
Together, these decisions will convert one existing share into 20 shares with a face value of 2 rupees.
The company stock price has risen 38 percent over the past year.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Share split and bonus issues reduce individual share prices for smaller buyers but do not change the company overall profit.

stories.headline: Emami vs Dabur Q2 results: Which FMCG giant wins on profit, revenue and dividend? Check target, upcoming record dates
stories.summary:
Emami and Dabur announced their second quarter financial results and dividends.
Emami net profit fell 1.92 percent to 145.50 crore rupees.
Dabur net profit rose 12.09 percent to 498.57 crore rupees.
Shares of both consumer companies rose nearly 7 percent over the past week.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Mixed profit growth among daily product makers shows uneven consumer spending in the country.

stories.headline: Exide beats Amara in Q2, but returns from lithium-ion investments will decide the winner
stories.summary:
Exide reported a 54 percent rise in second quarter profit due to strong demand and price hikes.
Amara Raja saw lower profits because raw material costs stayed high.
Both companies are investing heavily in new lithium battery projects.
Returns on these battery investments will decide future performance.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong profit growth in market leaders could boost interest in auto battery shares.

stories.headline: Why did RR Kabel share rally 8% during Muhurat Trading despite weak market sentiment — what triggered the surge?
stories.summary:
RR Kabel shares rose 8 percent to 2,073 rupees during the special trading session.
The stock price gain occurred alongside unusually high trading activity.
September quarter profit increased by 55.7 percent from a year ago.
Quarterly revenue also grew 51.8 percent compared to the same period last year.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Fast revenue and profit growth in electrical equipment makers could attract buyers to manufacturing stocks.
